in_marathi.name: Rajkishor
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Kings, Ruler of All
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajkishor हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj - king, Kishor - ruler, Rajkishor is the king of kings, the ruler of all. It is a powerful and royal name, evoking images of a majestic monarch.
